Original Fold5 was absent from development and acquired only after the full F3 freeze. Prior historical exposure remains a limitation.

Recorded technical failure. Initial M11 failed its archived-control reproduction tolerance despite matching data/source identities and recorded software versions. M11R separately compares the unchanged recipes against controls fitted on this same L4. It does not claim numerical reproduction of archived controls. Both attempts remain in RogNet.

NEW CAMPAIGN

WindNet Phase III

Open the new RogNet campaign. Campaign visibility is private while browser resumption for publication is pending. Earlier experiments remain in their original campaign. All training and holdout rules carry forward.

M17 planned, not run: a registered linear-versus-RBF kernel comparison on the same image features, with 144 conditions and unchanged adoption rules. Read the complete preregistration.

M16 · TRAINING-SIDE ONLY · 1,512 ORIGINAL VALIDATION WINDOWS

Does fitting transition shape improve the joint forecast?

No candidate passed every adoption requirement; M13 remains the training incumbent.

144 conditions · 36 raw recipes · 144 fold fits · 0 joint numerical passes · 0 interval checks.

Add an adjacent-window difference error to weighted ridge regression. Compare regional, morphology and combined features; ridge penalties 10, 100 and 1000; difference strengths 0, 0.25, 1 and 4; and four head shares with fixed M10. Every pair stays inside the original 13 fitting windows of one block. Forecasts still consume only the original four images.

The zero-strength regional control reproduced saved M13 predictions within 1e−7 before any positive-strength fit. Four frozen controls and original rows matched to 1e−9. Original Fold5 was hashed and discarded without parsing.

Full recorded ranges; all conditions retained. Point-score gains also require the registered fold and uncertainty screens.

M15 · TRAINING-SIDE FORECAST ROUTING · 1,512 ORIGINAL VALIDATION WINDOWS

Can conditional routing balance the two experts?

No gate passed every adoption requirement; M13 remains the training incumbent.

104 registered gates · 1 joint numerical passes · 1 fold-screen passes · 1 interval checks. No new base model was fitted.

Blend the fixed M14 morphology and regional-morphology anchor forecasts using either a constant weight or a sigmoid of the second expert’s predicted speed, then optionally mix with M13. The gate accepts predictions only. All base forecasts use identical original four-image information and rows; no observed speed, label or neighboring forecast enters the routing input.

Axes show the complete recorded range. A numerical pass does not imply adoption: the registered uncertainty and stability requirements also apply.

Can a monotone correction learned from fitting-only out-of-fold predictions improve high-speed event skill while improving every other original metric beyond M10?

Keep the ratio/flatten location head, precision weight 4, ridge penalty 10,000, location/M6 mixture 0.625/0.375, gain 1.2 and bias −5 fixed. Vary correction strength at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1. Strength 0 uses the fixed M10 recipe on this platform. An additional map learned from in-sample fitting predictions is an ablation and cannot be adopted.

Each outer split fits three of original Folds1–4 and validates the remaining fold. Inner cross-fitting holds out each fitting fold in turn. Inner scalers, precision weights and target anchors use inner fitting rows only. The fixed encoder uses the outer-fitting image mean throughout; this is not fully nested preprocessing.

Collin et al. (2025) motivates distribution correction for underestimated stream peaks. PROSWIN (2026) motivates balancing timeline and peak performance. Their results use different data and predictor budgets; neither is a matched comparator here.

Complete M11 panel

The stronger of fixed M10, matched WindNet port and M6 is the comparator for each metric. Adoption needs at least 1% lower RMSE, +0.005 correlation, 0.5% lower chi-square and +0.02 original HSE threat score, plus the registered stability checks. Undefined scores fail.

Boundaries and limitations

All models receive the same original four 211 Å images and use the original H4/D3 window construction. No in-situ history, additional wavelength or external solar predictor is added. Hypotheses use training-side observations only. Large earlier searches and reused development folds limit generalization claims. Conditional block-bootstrap intervals do not correct adaptive selection. Elicit is not used.
